resources.string: Select the provider for the WireGuard configuration
Could not read the configuration file

Most commercial VPN providers do not accept their normal website username and password directly through Android VpnService. They provide a WireGuard configuration or another tunnel-specific credential. This screen uses the official WireGuard Android tunnel backend and imports those provider configurations.

When a full-tunnel WireGuard configuration contains 0.0.0.0/0 and/or ::/0 in AllowedIPs, Android routes the device traffic through the VPN. The provider configuration controls the actual routes and DNS.
